# Backend: auth service

Users, sign-in, JWTs, roles, email verification, password reset and user provisioning (`backend/services/auth/`, package `auth/auth/`, port 8000).

- auth is the only service that writes users. Other services learn about users only through the `auth.user.created` event.
- New users that other services must know about are written to `users_outbox` in the **same transaction**; the outbox worker (`auth/outbox/`) publishes the event and welcome email. Never publish user-created events directly from a request.
- Tokens: subject carries `user_guid`, `role`, `email_verified`; token type is checked on decode. Changing claims affects every service, which validate tokens with the shared `JWT_ENCRYPTION_SECRET_KEY`.
- Role lists use `UserType`; `INTERNALE` is never a public role. Provisioning rules: admins create admins and owners; admins and owners create managers (with `organizationGuid`, passed on in the event); admins, owners and managers create customers.
- Internal endpoints live under `/internal/`, use `InternalRequestDep` (loopback only) and no JWT.
- `ENVIRONMENT=local` verifies new users' email and gives provisioned users `Password@123`; never rely on it outside local development.
- Email messages (forgot password, OTP, welcome) are published to the email exchange through `get_mq_client()`; the notification service renders them.

Details: `docs/backend/auth.md`, `docs/architecture/auth-and-roles.md`, `docs/architecture/messaging.md`.
